title: Specifying AI-SDLC Processes: A Protocol Language for Human-Agent Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2606.20615v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents now act as first-class members of the software development lifecycle, but the instruments teams use to direct them enforce nothing: process encoded in prompts is flexible but unenforceable, while workflow formalisms are enforceable but do not model autonomous agents. We propose a domain-specific language for specifying AI-SDLC processes as protocols, with formal abstract syntax, well-formedness conditions, operational semantics, and enforcement invariants, organised around a separation of policy (declared intent) from mechanism (structural enforcement). We prove that any well-formed protocol maintains its invariants on every execution trace, closed under Kleene composition of orchestration loops: protocol steps cannot be skipped, by construction. translated_title: 指定AI-SDLC流程：一种用于人机边界的协议语言
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.20615v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：AI代理现在作为软件开发生命周期中的一等成员，但团队用于指导它们的工具并无强制力：编码在提示中的流程灵活但不可强制执行，而工作流形式化虽可强制执行却未建模自主代理。我们提出了一种特定领域语言，将AI-SDLC流程指定为协议，具备正式抽象语法、良构条件、操作语义和强制不变量，围绕策略（声明意图）与机制（结构强制）的分离进行组织。我们证明了任何良构协议在其每次执行轨迹上保持其不变量，并在编排循环的Kleene复合下封闭：协议步骤在构造上不可跳过。故障率分析推导出两个后果：结构强制限制了静默故障，同时将剩余部分转化为可见、可审计的停滞，且该收益在...（此处摘要截断）
tldr: 提出一种用于指定AI-SDLC流程的协议语言，通过策略与机制分离及形式化不变量，确保流程步骤不可跳过，将静默故障转化为可见审计停滞。
en_tdlr: Proposes a protocol language for specifying AI-SDLC processes that separates policy from mechanism with formal invariants, ensuring steps cannot be skipped and converting silent failures into auditable stalls.
